_note: Vent register for the whole craft. Every source of air, gas, fumes or odour that leaves a space is listed here with its hazard class, its outlet and its separation group. Outlet locations are placeholders until the general arrangement is dimensioned. Hazard classes: H (flammable or toxic gas and vapour), O (odour and contamination), C (combustion exhaust), A (occupied-space air supply and extract). The validator enforces that H, O and C sources never share an outlet with A or with each other.

hazard_classes.H: Flammable or toxic gas and vapour (battery off-gas, paint solvent, fuel vapour). Explosion-proof equipment, dedicated ducts, outlet clear of intakes and people.
hazard_classes.C: Combustion exhaust (diesel gensets, engine rooms). Hot, corrosive, must be routed away from intakes and people.
hazard_classes.O: Odour and contamination (waste, pet areas, bilges, galley extract, laundry). Dedicated extract, no recirculation into occupied spaces.
hazard_classes.A: Occupied-space supply and extract (cabins, lounges, bridge, medical bay). Fresh-air intake, filtered, positive pressure to hazardous spaces.

sources.outlet: Gas-tight exhaust to a safe outside point; separate from all other ducts
sources.notes: Sealed room (IP67). Closed-loop cooling. Pressure relief for thermal events. Breather must not be PTFE.

sources.outlet: Dedicated low-level extraction to a safe outside point
sources.notes: Explosion-proof equipment. Vapour detection with door interlock.

sources.outlet: Tank vents to a safe outside point, fitted with flame screens
sources.notes: Vents must not discharge near intakes, people or the tender stowage.

sources.outlet: Stack at the top of the outdoor pilot house roof, clear of sail operations (owner request, not accepted: occupied outdoor helm and guest roof)
sources.notes: Hot, corrosive exhaust with soot and oxides of nitrogen. OWNER REQUEST NOT ACCEPTED: the pilot house roof is the outdoor helm (Station B), the sun deck and events area, and a guest area. Combustion exhaust at occupied roof level is blocked pending review. See docs/genset-exhaust-and-systems.md.

sources.space: Engine and generator room air (combustion air and cooling)
sources.outlet: Engine room extract to outside, separate from genset exhaust
sources.notes: Combustion air intake must be drawn from a clean, outside point.

sources.outlet: Dedicated extract to outside; no recirculation
sources.notes: Odour and ammonia. Must not share a duct with guest cabins or galley.

sources.outlet: Dedicated extract, drained to a separate waste route
sources.notes: Humidity and odour. Keep separate from the battery room.

sources.outlet: Galley hood extract to outside, grease-filtered
sources.notes: Grease and cooking odour. Must not share a duct with cabins or the medical bay.

sources.outlet: Bilge and wastewater vent to outside, fitted with an odour filter
sources.notes: Odour and possible fumes from wastewater. Keep clear of intakes.

sources.outlet: Workshop extract to outside, with fume extraction at the bench
sources.notes: Solvents, welding and grinding fumes. Separate from the paint store extract.

sources.outlet: Extract to outside through filtered path, pressure-controlled
sources.notes: Isolation capability and filtration. Positive pressure to the treatment room, negative to isolation.

sources.outlet: Extract to outside, fresh-air intake from a clean outside point
sources.notes: Occupied spaces. Positive pressure relative to hazardous spaces.

sources.outlet: Extract to outside, fresh-air intake from a clean outside point
Dedicated extract to a safe outside point (outboard fuel and battery fumes)
sources.notes: Fuel and battery fumes. Must not share a duct with the battery room or paint store.

sources.outlet: AWG air exhaust to outside, clear of every intake and outdoor space
sources.notes: Moves large volumes of outside air and discharges warm, humid air. Intake from a clean outside point. Units must be foam-free. See docs/water-supply-scaling.md.
